therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Cell cycle arrest and mitotic catastrophe in dividing tumor cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with relapsed or refractory aggressive B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL, transformed follicular lymphoma, mantle cell lymphoma, Burkitt's lymphoma)

results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional increases in alisertib plasma concentrations observed across dose levels
results.dose_information: Alisertib 30mg, 40mg, or 50mg enteric coated tablets with rituximab +/- vincristine
